decision.reason: [ev-57c05cdbb7d0] is one changelog line saying the default servers transport SPIFFE config is now "enforced". It doesn't say what was wrong before, what behaviour changed, which configurations are affected (for example, SPIFFE set on the default transport versus on per-service transports) or what happens to an exposed setup after upgrading. It only points to PR #9444 for details, so applicability and consequence can't be written without the PR description or the docs.
